metadata.title: Qhapaq
metadata.description: Qhapaq — verifiable participation in real-world projects on Stellar Testnet.

project.overviewTitle: Verifiable participation in a coastal resort
project.shortDescription: A coastal hospitality project inviting verifiable community participation through QRP on Stellar Testnet.

overview.p1: Huaral Resort brings guests a calm Pacific retreat north of Lima — pools, dining, and wellness spaces designed for long stays and local weekends.
overview.p2: Qhapaq lets supporters participate with QRP, a classic Stellar Testnet asset that represents project participation for this hackathon prototype — not legal shares or securities.
overview.p3: Holding QRP unlocks a 20% discount on resort services, giving participation a clear, tangible benefit.

discount.title: Resort services discount
discount.description: Participants receive 20% off lodging, dining, and spa services when visiting Huaral Resort.

priority.title: Priority booking window
priority.description: Early access to seasonal packages and peak-weekend reservations before general release.

updates.description: Transparent progress notes on funding, construction milestones, and guest experience improvements.

project.disclaimer: QRP on Stellar Testnet is a hackathon prototype for verifiable participation. It is not a security, equity share, or investment product.
